pr_title: [CI] Extend bisect parameters through AOP workflows
source_quote:
if/else/fi indentation confusion
if/else/fi indentation confusion

rule.description: Shell 脚本中 if/else/fi 块内的代码必须缩进到对应层级，使控制流结构清晰可读。else 块内的代码缩进应与 then 块内的代码保持一致。
checkpoints: 检查 if/elif/else/fi 块内的代码缩进是否与控制结构层级一致
确认 else 块内的代码没有遗漏缩进（常见于从其他位置粘贴代码时）
确认嵌套 if/else 的缩进逐层递增

antipattern.code:
if [ -n "${BISECT_GOOD_COMMIT:-}" ]; then
        echo "  Explicit good commit supplied; skipping good-table lookup and age gate"
    else
    echo "  Looking up: ${case_name}"          # ❌ 缺少缩进
    if [ ! -f "$table" ]; then                  # ❌ 缺少缩进
        echo "  Table file not found: ${table}"
        echo "  Decision: no table → SKIP"
        return 1
    fi
    age_gate=$(stat -c %Y "$table" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$age_gate" -lt "$MIN_TABLE_AGE" ]; then
        echo "  Table too young (${age_gate}s < ${MIN_TABLE_AGE}s) → SKIP"
        return 1
    fi
    # ... else 块内所有代码都没有缩进
    fi

    if [ "$condition" = "true" ]; then
        echo "  true branch"
    else
    echo "  false branch"                      # ❌ 缺少缩进
    if [ "$sub" = "yes" ]; then                # ❌ 缺少缩进
        echo "  nested"
    fi
    fi
antipattern.context: ... else 块内所有代码都没有缩进

pattern.code:
if [ -n "${BISECT_GOOD_COMMIT:-}" ]; then
        echo "  Explicit good commit supplied; skipping good-table lookup and age gate"
    else
        echo "  Looking up: ${case_name}"      # ✅ 正确缩进
        if [ ! -f "$table" ]; then              # ✅ 正确缩进
            echo "  Table file not found: ${table}"
            echo "  Decision: no table → SKIP"
            return 1
        fi
        age_gate=$(stat -c %Y "$table" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        if [ "$age_gate" -lt "$MIN_TABLE_AGE" ]; then
            echo "  Table too young (${age_gate}s < ${MIN_TABLE_AGE}s) → SKIP"
            return 1
        fi
        # ... else 块内所有代码都有正确缩进
    fi

    if [ "$condition" = "true" ]; then
        echo "  true branch"
    else
        echo "  false branch"                  # ✅ 正确缩进
        if [ "$sub" = "yes" ]; then            # ✅ 正确缩进
            echo "  nested"
        fi
    fi
pattern.context: ... else 块内所有代码都有正确缩进
